entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-03-11
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • CS0027 Breaking change for Attributes and this in .NET Core 10.0.200 #82709
  • False positive IDE0051 and IDE0052, regression from 10.0.103 and 10.0.104. #82704

Closed

  • Nullability tracking is broken for `Nullable<T>` with awaits #76886
    18.4
  • [LSP] - should we get relatedDocuments when making pull diagnostic request #82652
  • Dependency resolution warning: Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Analyzers version mismatch for Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.Scripting 5.3.0 #82701
  • Warnings (at least CS1998) are not showing with SDK 10 compared to SDK 9 #82692
  • Assertion in `BindsToTryStatement` on `lock(expression)` #82694
  • Ambiguous overload error on extension method with `params` overload when receiver is a base type when called with a derived type #82689
  • Assertions in nullable walker when opening Roslyn's LanguageParser.cs #82464
    18.5
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-11610.57 #82693

    Area-Analyzers
